name: Miyama (Mie, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Miyama town emblem in light blue: a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised letter M.
history: Flag of the former town of Miyama in Mie Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-10-11. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 August 1959.

features.role: Miyama town emblem — a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised letter M
